sottotitolo: Manage your account, privacy, and data deletion.
bioDescDisponibile: Requires biometric authentication when you open the app.
bioPromptVerifica: Turn on unlock with Face ID or fingerprint
pendingBody: Your deletion request is being processed. The school office will handle it shortly (within 30 days). You can still cancel it if you’ve changed your mind.
eliminaSpiegazione: The request is sent to the school office, which irreversibly anonymises your personal data (name, contacts, documents) and disconnects your access. Data for children still enrolled stays managed by the school; tax documents are kept as required by law.
